gaming.disableGameBarDesc: Disable GameBar controller shortcuts and startup panel
gaming.disableGameDVRDesc: Disable Game DVR background recording, free system resources
gaming.disableAutoColorMgmtDesc: Disable DirectX auto color management, reduce GPU overhead
gaming.gameModeDesc: Enable Windows Game Mode to automatically suspend background tasks while gaming and prioritize resources for the game
gaming.win32PriorityDesc: Configure how Windows allocates CPU time between foreground applications and background services. Programs mode is more responsive (recommended)
gaming.systemResponsivenessDesc: Reduce the CPU time MMCSS reserves for background tasks so games get more CPU resources
gaming.hagsDesc: Enable Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling so the GPU manages its own memory and scheduling, reducing latency
gaming.backgroundServicesDesc: Reduce the Windows service startup timeout from 60 to 30 seconds for a slightly faster boot
gaming.disableMpoDesc: Disable multi-plane overlay compositing to fix screen flickering, black screens, and stuttering on multi-monitor setups

nvidia.lowLatencyThresholdDesc: Set GPU scheduler latency thresholds to minimum, reduce input lag
nvidia.perCpuDCPDesc: Distribute GPU interrupts across cores, reduce single-core latency
nvidia.imageSharpeningDesc: Enable Image Sharpening globally, improve clarity
nvidia.disableGpuPowerMgmtDesc: Disable runtime power management and ASPM, maintain peak performance
nvidia.disableHDCPDesc: Disable HDCP handshake overhead, reduce display latency
nvidia.disableWriteCombiningDesc: Disable Write Combining, reduce GPU latency
nvidia.disableTelemetryDesc: Disable GeForce Experience telemetry data collection
nvidia.disableDriverLogDesc: Disable driver internal logging, reduce overhead
nvidia.lockPState0Desc: Lock maximum performance state, prevent GPU downclocking
nvidia.disableMiracastOverlayDesc: Disable Miracast casting and driver overlay

amd.shaderCacheDesc: Force enable shader cache, reduce game stuttering
amd.amdPowerOptimizationDesc: Disable ULPS, power gating and dynamic p-states to reduce GPU power-state latency

intel.intelGraphicsOptimizationDesc: Disable async flips and adaptive vsync to reduce display latency and tearing

performance.mergeSvcHostDesc: Increase split threshold, reduce svchost process count
performance.disablePowerSavingDesc: Disable PowerThrottling and hibernation (not for laptops)
performance.nvmeTuningDesc: Continuous memory allocation, disable logging and idle power saving
performance.disableMenuDelayDesc: Menus open instantly on hover (MenuShowDelay=0) for faster response
performance.keyboardLatencyDesc: Shortest repeat delay and fastest repeat rate for snappier input
performance.disableAutoCompleteDesc: Disable auto-suggest and append completion in the Run dialog and Explorer
performance.disableWindowShakeDesc: Shaking a title bar no longer minimizes other windows, avoiding accidental triggers
performance.enableLowDiskCheckDesc: Keep low-disk-space detection on to prevent disks from filling up and hurting performance
performance.disableLinkResolveDesc: Broken shortcuts no longer trigger full-disk searches or web lookups, speeding up access
performance.excludeWUDriversDesc: Stop Windows Update from pushing driver updates automatically, avoiding driver overwrite issues
performance.ifeoProcessTuningDesc: Block compatibility telemetry processes via IFEO and lower background process priorities

privacy.disableErrorReportingDesc: Disable WER, stop error data upload
privacy.disableAdvertisingIdDesc: Disable the personalized advertising ID that apps use to track your activity and show targeted ads
privacy.disableAdsPromotionalDesc: Master switch: disable all advertising, suggestions, and promotional content in Start menu, lock screen, Settings, and Notification Center
privacy.disableOnlineSpeechRecognitionDesc: Prevent sending speech data to Microsoft cloud for processing
privacy.disableTailoredExperiencesDesc: Prevent personalized suggestions, tips, and ads based on diagnostic data
privacy.disableMsaCloudSearchDesc: Prevent search from using Microsoft account cloud search services
privacy.disableLockScreenSpotlightDesc: Stop showing Bing daily images and promotional content on the lock screen
privacy.disableInkingDictionaryDesc: Prevent using your typing and handwriting history to create a personalized dictionary
privacy.disableFeedbackRequestsDesc: Stop Windows from periodically asking you to provide feedback
privacy.disableCortanaDesc: Turn off Cortana, Bing web search, and search history
privacy.disableNewsAndInterestsDesc: Disable the taskbar News and Interests feed to reduce background activity
privacy.disableCloudOptimizedContentDesc: Disable cloud optimized content (app updates and file sync) to save bandwidth
privacy.disableEdgeTelemetryDesc: Disable Edge personalization reporting, feedback, and metrics; also disables Edge update services
privacy.disableVisualStudioTelemetryDesc: Disable VS telemetry switch, feedback collection, and the SQM program
privacy.disableChromeTelemetryDesc: Disable Chrome metrics reporting, cleanup reporting, and feedback collection
privacy.disableFirefoxTelemetryDesc: Disable Firefox telemetry and the default browser agent via enterprise policy
privacy.disableActivityFeedDesc: Disable the Timeline activity feed, stop recording recent activities
privacy.disableCdpDesc: Prevent the Connected Devices Platform from collecting data for analysis and targeting
privacy.disableDiagnosticsToastDesc: Set diagnostic data level to Basic and reduce diagnostic popups
privacy.disableHandwritingSharingDesc: Prevent handwriting samples from being shared with Microsoft services
privacy.disableTextInputCollectionDesc: Prevent Windows from storing and analyzing your typed linguistic data
privacy.disableInputPersonalizationDesc: Disable cloud input personalization (prediction and autocorrect learning) via policy
privacy.disableActivityUploadsDesc: Stop uploading user activity history to the Microsoft cloud
privacy.disableMessageSyncDesc: Block cross-device sync of SMS and notifications; messages stay on this device
privacy.disableSettingSyncDesc: Disable cross-device sync of credentials and app settings
privacy.disableVoiceActivationDesc: Force-deny voice activation for apps so they cannot listen for voice commands
privacy.disableFindMyDeviceDesc: Turn off device location reporting; a lost device cannot be located remotely

ai.disableCopilotDesc: Disable Copilot via group policy and remove Shell integration, keyboard hardware key, and runtime
ai.disableRecallSnapshotsDesc: Prevent Windows Recall from saving snapshots of your activity
ai.blockRecallEnablementDesc: Prevent Windows Recall from being enabled via policy
ai.disableAiDataAnalysisDesc: Prevent Windows AI from analyzing user data for personalization and recommendations
ai.disableClickToDoDesc: Disable the Windows Click to Do AI feature
ai.disableAiSettingsAgentDesc: Disable the AI-powered Settings Agent feature
ai.disableAgentConnectorsDesc: Prevent AI agents from using connectors to access external services
ai.disableAgentWorkspacesDesc: Disable the Windows AI Agent Workspaces feature
ai.disableRemoteAgentConnectorsDesc: Prevent AI agents from using remote connectors to access remote services

services.disableRemoteRegistryDesc: Disable the RemoteRegistry service to block remote registry access
services.disableSysMainDesc: Disable the SysMain (Superfetch) service and prefetcher; recommended on SSDs
services.disableSystemRestoreDesc: Disable restore point creation via policy; existing restore points are kept
services.disableSMBv1Desc: Disable the SMBv1 protocol with known critical vulnerabilities (a main ransomware attack vector)
services.disableSMBv2Desc: Disable the SMBv2 protocol; LAN file sharing will stop working, use with caution

disk.disableFullFsSearchDesc: Only search indexed locations, reduce disk scanning
disk.ntfsMftZoneDesc: Reserve 25%-37% of the disk for the Master File Table to reduce fragmentation

apps.disableEdgeStartupBoostDesc: Disable Edge pre-launch and background running
apps.slimEdgeAdsDesc: Disable sidebar, ads, shopping assistant, etc.

apps.disableStoreAutoUpdateDesc: Stop Microsoft Store from auto-updating apps and disable consumer features and promo popups

windowsUpdate.pageDesc: Completely disable Windows auto-update and Windows Defender (both reversible)
windowsUpdate.disableSuccess: Windows Update has been successfully disabled

windowsUpdate.warningDesc: After disabling Windows Update, you will no longer receive security patches and feature updates. It is recommended to manually check for updates periodically or re-enable when needed.

pauseCard.title: Pause Windows Update (1000 Weeks)
pauseCard.desc: Pause Windows Update for about 1000 weeks (~19 years). After writing to the registry, you need to manually adjust the pause duration in Windows Update settings.
pauseCard.manualHint: After writing successfully, open Settings → Windows Update → Pause Updates and manually adjust the pause duration to the maximum value, otherwise the registry time will not take effect.

defenderCard.title: Windows Defender Real-time Protection
defenderCard.desc: Disable Windows Defender real-time protection (antispyware/antivirus, behavior monitoring, file access protection, etc.) via group policy. Can be restored anytime.
defenderCard.applySuccess: Windows Defender has been successfully disabled
defenderCard.restoreSuccess: Windows Defender has been successfully restored
defenderCard.manualHint: After disabling, the system will no longer provide virus and threat protection. If 'Tamper Protection' is on, Windows may reset these policies automatically. Turn off 'Tamper Protection' in Defender settings first for this to take effect.

gpuDriverRestart.pageDesc: Disable all graphics drivers then re-enable automatically (more thorough than Win+Ctrl+Shift+B, requires administrator)
gpuDriverRestart.detailDesc: Clicking the button will disable all display adapters on the system and automatically re-enable them after a few seconds, achieving a complete unload and reload of the graphics driver. The screen will briefly go black and return to normal within seconds. Administrator privileges are required.
gpuDriverRestart.success: Graphics driver disabled and re-enabled, screen may briefly go black
gpuDriverRestart.waiting: Disabling and re-enabling graphics driver, please wait...
gpuDriverRestart.warningDesc: This operation will disable all graphics drivers first, then automatically re-enable them. The screen will briefly go black for a few seconds. Make sure no important tasks (such as gaming or file editing) are in progress. If re-enabling fails, you may need to restart the computer to restore the display. Suitable for display anomalies, artifacts, stuttering, and applying GPU renames. Windows only. Administrator privileges required.
